module: Flowgraph node "Category Test" (category once_f_duration), a test node for this category: on flow, switches to the duration state "started", counts 5 seconds (mgr.dtReal) with a progress bar in the node, then switches to "finished". No custom pins.
notes: Bug: in work(), `not self.durationState == 'started'` is evaluated as `(not self.durationState) == 'started'`, always false; the guard therefore protects nothing and the timer advances even outside the started state.

onNodeReset.desc: Resets the timer and the state.

work.desc: Advances the timer and switches to 'finished' at 5 s.
